algorithm.description: The key derivation function algorithm to use (e.g., PBKDF2, HKDF, SCRYPT)

key.description: The input keying material in hexadecimal format

salt.description: The salt value in hexadecimal format

iterations.description: The iteration count for the key derivation function

output_length.description: The desired output length in bytes

prf.description: The pseudo-random function to use (e.g., sha256, sha512) if required by the algorithm
